title: IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale 8.6.1.0 through 8.6.2.2 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due…
description: IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale versions 8.6.1.0 through 8.6.2.2 contain a vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass security restrictions due to improper Content Security Policy configuration. This flaw could enable unauthorized access or actions by circumventing intended security controls. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 9.1, indicating critical impact on confidentiality and integrity without requiring user interaction or privileges.
